implementation.transport: target/m68k TCG helper with direct CPU-state and guest-memory access
implementation.fallback: Execute the native translated loop unless the control, D4=64 loop count, fractional EMAC mode, and full-mask guards all pass.

conclusion: The third direct-state helper matches the stock outer loop at two cursor positions and lowers the exact 100-service ISR profile by 41.20% relative to native execution. The result is independent of shared-host wall timing.
next_gate: Profile the remaining renderer with all three helpers enabled and promote the largest independently replayable bounded hotspot.
